_about: Philis sidecar: every rule, layer, device and PEX value comes from the GPurify deck named here; this file holds only what the checker does not read (layer roles, generator dimensions, process coefficients).

cell.bjt_ka_pct_um_source: textbook, not gf180mcu: Hastings, The Art of Analog Layout, §10.2.1 (PDF p.507), I_S mismatch area constant of a bipolar pair; replace with the PDK's own figure when one is published.
cell.vbe_tc_uv_per_k_source: textbook, not gf180mcu: Hastings, The Art of Analog Layout, §9.1 (PDF p.433), |dV_BE/dT| ~ 2 mV/K.
cell.wpe_clearance_nm_source: Hastings §13.3 rule 19 (hastings.txt L42625–42631, H13-53): well edge to matched gates, EXC the lower bound of 5–10 µm; [MIN, MOD, EXC], same on every deck.
cell.lod_moat_ext_nm_source: Hastings §13.2.2 (hastings.txt L41411–41422, H13-29) 'two or three microns will suffice' for less accurate matching (MIN); §13.3 rule 12 (L42532–42553, H13-47) MOD STI ≥ 5 µm, EXC ≥ 10 µm; [MIN, MOD, EXC], same on every deck.
cell.dummy_reach_nm_source: Hastings §13.3 rule 12 (hastings.txt L42532–42553, H13-47): MIN dummies optional, MOD one full dummy for L < ~3 µm, EXC outer dummy poly edge ≥ 10 µm from the active gates; [MIN, MOD, EXC], same on every deck.
cell.gate_ext_extra_nm_source: Hastings §13.3 rule 21 (hastings.txt L42638–42647, H13-54): extend gate poly 1–2 µm beyond the rule for MOD/EXC (lower end taken); [MIN, MOD, EXC], same on every deck.
cell.res_dummy_span_nm_source: Hastings §8 resistor dummies (hastings.txt L22312–22347, L25263–25273, H08-13): MIN one minimum-width dummy, MOD one full-width dummy, EXC dummies spanning ≥ 10 µm; [MIN, MOD, EXC], same on every deck.
cell.res_width_floor_permille_source: Hastings §8 resistor width floors (hastings.txt L25205–25214, H08-41): 150/200/400 % of minimum width; [MIN, MOD, EXC], same on every deck.
cell.res_length_floor_x_source: Hastings §8 resistor length floors (hastings.txt L25274–25281, H08-41): 3×/5×/10× minimum length; [MIN, MOD, EXC], same on every deck.
cell.dummy_max_l_nm_source: microloading reach 3-5 um, hastings.txt L41097-41104 (H13-26); Philis policy: the lower end
cell.cap_density_ff_um2_source: UNVERIFIED: no source was recorded with this value.
cell.em_current_density_source: EM.metal1_metal5 and EM.metaltop from the installed tech LEF gf180mcuD/libs.ref/gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0/techlef/gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0__nom.tlef (volare gf180mcu c6d73a35): DCCURRENTDENSITY AVERAGE Metal1-Metal4 0.67 mA/um, Via1-Via4 0.18 mA per via, top Metal5 1.5 mA/um. That LEF is 5LM with Metal5 as top; this deck's stack is metal1-5 + metaltop, so its top (metaltop) gets 1.5, metal1-5 get 0.67, and every via (via1-via5) 0.18. Stored as uA/um and uA/cut. Replaces unsourced values (1.0 mA/um, 0.21/0.28 mA/cut, top 1.8). EM.poly2 dropped: no poly EM limit in the PDK files.
cell.em_derating_source: pdks/decks/gf180mcu.deck:486 "Electromigration at 85 C" [DRM 54, tables 14.3/14.4]; Ea and n not stated
cell.antenna_source: ANT.2..ANT.6 sidewall_thickness 550 -> 540 nm to match the installed PDK: libs.tech/klayout/drc/rule_decks/antenna.drc 'perimeter_only(metalN, 0.54.um)' and techlef gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0__nom.tlef THICKNESS 0.54 ({GFV}). Ratios (ANT.1 200, ANT.2-6 400, ANT.8 10, ANT.9-13 20) agree with antenna.drc. The checker runs these sidewall rules, and Pdk::antenna_rule reads them for routing. Metaltop (ANT.7, ratio 400) not added: its thickness depends on the metal_top option (0.69/0.99/1.19/3.035 um) the deck does not state.
cell.avt_n_mv_um_source: nfet_03v3 Monte Carlo of the installed models: benchmarks/characterize_mismatch.py gf180mcu 250 1|2, ngspice-44.2, design.ngspice + '.lib sm141064.ngspice typical' with sw_stat_mismatch=1, ngbehavior=hsa (volare gf180mcu c6d73a35 (gf180mcuD)); 250 pairs x 6 W/L (1/0.28..8/2 um), diode-connected, constant-current VT at 0.1uA*W/L, sigma(dVT) fit through origin vs 1/sqrt(WL); seeds 1,2 gave 8.88, 8.9 -> 8.9. Model card (fets_mm): par_vth 7.148 mV.um on effective area (L-0.15um); mulu0 mismatch adds the rest.
cell.avt_p_mv_um_source: pfet_03v3, same run: seeds 1,2 gave 8.47, 8.48 -> 8.5. Model card par_vth 6.66 mV.um on effective area.
cell.vt_tc_uv_per_k_source: nfet_03v3 benchmarks/characterize_mismatch.py tc gf180mcu, ngspice-44.2, '.lib sm141064.ngspice typical' (volare gf180mcu c6d73a35 (gf180mcuD)), diode-connected, constant-current VT at 0.1uA*W/L, temp 0/27/85/125 C, least-squares slope: 2/0.5 um -1150, 4/1 um -1108 uV/K -> 1130 (magnitude; VT falls with T). The library reads this single key; pfet in vt_tc_uv_per_k_p.
cell.svt_uv_per_um_source: PROXY, not gf180mcu data: Schaper & Linnenbank, 'Comparison of distance mismatch and pair matching of CMOS devices' (Infineon 130 nm, IEEE), Table 1, thin-oxide nMOS S_D [mV/mm = uV/um]: L/W 0.12/1.6 1.63, 0.24/1.6 0.780, 0.24/12.8 0.941, 0.48/1.6 0.582, 0.48/3.2 0.644; S_D grows as L shrinks (Fig. 8, S_D^2 ~ 1/Leff^2). gf180 3.3V Lmin 0.28 um lies between the 0.24 and 0.48 rows; took the larger of the two L=0.24 values (0.941), an upper bound for L>=0.24 given S_D falls with L. Planar 180 nm vs 130 nm source process.

resistors.note: GPurify gf180mcu.deck: ppolyf_u_r = (poly2 and pplus and sab and res_mk) not interacting resistor, npolyf_u_r = poly2 and nplus and sab and res_mk; res_mk cuts poly2_con, so the heads are two nets.

waivers.multiple_drivers: Analog: a node driven by two drains (a differential pair's output and its load, a mirror's input) is the circuit, not a fault. The rule counts distinct gate nets driving a net (a digital fan-in check).
